ModMetaData.name: Lumen Stones - AutoConfig preset
ModMetaData.author: KyleMHB
ModMetaData.description: Optional example preset that enables Lumen Stones content and preserves the active mod list's balance. Base Epochs - Pyrinth overrides remain off. Pyrinth columns require Epochs - Pyrinth. Importing the preset replaces saved Lumen Stones settings. See docs/stone-settings.md in Lumen Stones for the settings format.
